violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the three compartment sink and wiping cloth buckets with a concentration of 150 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. The automatic dispenser was not properly dispensing the product. The manager corrected this by manually adjusting the sanitizer concentration by adding product to the three compartment sink sanitizer basin and each of the wiping cloth containers. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: garlic and ginger in oil on the cook line was 63º F and being held at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Garlic in oil is considered a TCS food and must be held either hot or cold, and not at room temperature. The manager stated the container is emptied frequently, at least every two hours. The ESH explained that time as a public health control could be used if requested. The manager discarded the product to correct. CDI.
